safetyCars.source: https://www.motorsportmagazine.com/archive/article/may-1993/10/cardinal-senna ('The pace car had come out on lap 30' ... 'It was lap 37 before the racing resumed')
safetyCars.note: Wikipedia has the Suzuki/Katayama crashes that caused it on lap 27; Motor Sport puts Suzuki's crash on his 28th lap and the car out on lap 30. A fan wiki table (f1.fandom) says laps 29-38. Motor Sport chosen (contemporary, gives both ends).

notes: Senna also served a 10 s stop-and-go before the rain (penalty issued on lap 25 per Wikipedia; lap served not given). Schumacher's slick stop, Alesi's two stop-and-gos (20 s and 10 s), Katayama's and Suzuki's early stops, and most slick stops: no laps. Prost (#2) stayed out and crashed on lap 29. Weather: Schumacher's lap-41 stop is a stop-and-go (no tyre change) and his slick stop has no lap, so his stint from lap 42 is estimated (slicks). Cars with no sourced wet stop run their start slicks through the rain: the snapshot invents no stops.
